{{Quote|This is information operative Bax Kholer. I've assembled the list of prisoners with the skills to breach Megasecurity Ward 23.|Bax Kholer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bax Kholer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] operative of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], he was on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and assisted [[Cipher Nine]] with breaking into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]] by suggesting to use certain [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] to break inside.
